tool_input.command:
git add CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m "$(cat -- <<'EOF'
docs(changelog): correct install doctor-step and panic-fix bullets

The install bullet described round 4/5's forced -c/--config, now
reverted; reword to describe install's actual final behavior. The
panic-fix bullet claimed the eager DefaultConfigPath()-as-argument
pattern fired unconditionally on every poll tick regardless of
success -- that pattern never existed on main. On main both call
sites only fell back to DefaultConfigPath() inside the os.ErrNotExist
branch, so the panic there could only fire during an actual fallback.
EOF
)"
